headline: Nevish Line Rises to Fore as Weathered Expanse Leads Ledger
war_summary: Since our last edition the Nevish Line has risen to the fore, with twenty base actions on the day's ledger and word from Blackcoat Way — struck a dozen times — filed within a quarter hour of press. The Weathered Expanse still leads all fronts at thirty-nine actions, Crow's Nest and Wightwalk hardest pressed, its latest word at 17:10 and losses on both sides counted in the thousands daily. The Stlican Shelf keeps up its churning about Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town, twenty-eight actions to its credit. Palantine Berm counts twelve, chiefly at Leiri Hermanni and the Pippeli Stones. New since our last report, Kuura Strand shows a flare within the past two hours about Talven, and Fisherman's Row notes movement at Black Well. Callahan's Passage, Linn of Mercy and Mooring County have filed no fresh base events since morning, though the casualty returns of Callahan's and Linn of Mercy run heavy and climb anew, and Stonecradle has been still since 08:30. It is day 457 of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
